if: the document is a revised tax invoice referred to in section 31
it is issued under rule 53(1) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: UNKNOWN — the printed clause reads 'nature of the document'. Do NOT report a revised tax invoice as defective for omitting it until the effect of Notf no. 03/2019-CT is confirmed against the notification.
note: This record was written as a mandatory particular and then downgraded: the quote is in the source, but the source's own footnote says the clause was omitted. A quote that verifies is not the same as a rule that binds. The identical particular DOES bind a credit or debit note under rule 53(1A)(b), which carries no omission footnote — see GST-INV-FIELD-053A-B.
